subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should the canonical fix land as the broader channel attachment repair, a narrow config-gated group-chat fallback, or a combined config-gated channel/group repair?
rationale: The remaining decision is not whether the bug exists; it is which fallback/config policy maintainers want before a linked PR can safely close the canonical issue.

options.title: Land full channel repair first
options.body: Use the broader channel fix path or fold its team AAD group ID and thread-reply URL repairs into the landing PR before closing this issue.

options.title: Narrow to group-chat fallback
options.body: Keep the config-gated PR scoped to group chats and leave this channel attachment issue open for the broader channel URL repair.

options.title: Combine config gate with channel fixes
options.body: Require an opt-in fallback setting but also include the channel team GUID and reply URL repairs so one PR can close this issue.

recommendation.title: Land full channel repair first
recommendation.body: Use the broader channel fix path or fold its team AAD group ID and thread-reply URL repairs into the landing PR before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: History points to this as a Microsoft Teams plugin-boundary and config-surface product choice, and steipete has the strongest feature-history routing signal among the likely owners.
